description: Seen 2026-10-07 recording Codex 0.160.0: a Return from `muster pane send` (with the text, or alone a second later) does not submit a command typed into Codex's `!` shell mode, while a raw \\r written to the pty does. title: A Return sent by pane send into Codex's ! shell mode is not taken
